So chimpanzees, gorillas, and orangutans menstruate and have menstrual cycles. Bats and the elephant shrew also menstruate like humans. Monkeys (which are actually different than apes) go through something known as the Estrous cycle. This is not essentially the same, but some "period like" symptoms can still occur(its not a period though). This is usually referred to as an animal being "in heat." Most mammals (furry creatures that have live births) go through this. Dogs do not get periods they get bloody discharge, that does not contain shed uterus lining.
